question: The introduction of the Permanent Settlement in Bengal by Lord Cornwallis in 1793 primarily aimed to:

options.text: Ensure the welfare of the peasant farmers.
Create a class of loyal zamindars who would ensure regular land revenue collection.
Promote the cultivation of cash crops like indigo and cotton.

solution:
The correct answer is __**Create a class of loyal zamindars who would ensure regular land revenue collection.**__.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Permanent Settlement** was introduced in **1793** by **Lord Cornwallis** during British rule in India, specifically in the provinces of **Bengal, Bihar, and Odisha**. 
• The primary objective of the settlement was to create a class of **loyal zamindars (landlords)** who would act as intermediaries between the British administration and the peasants and ensure the **regular collection of land revenue**. 
• Zamindars were made the **hereditary owners of the land** under their control and were required to pay a fixed amount of revenue to the British government, irrespective of the agricultural output or economic conditions.
